children: Yukon Metals plans a fully subscribed private placement of up to 25,609,756 flow-through units at $0.205 each for gross proceeds of up to $5.25M. Closing is expected on or about Dec. 10, 2026, subject to customary conditions and approvals.
Placement targets up to C$5.25M gross
Provides planned exploration funding, but proceeds are not yet closed and completion remains subject to conditions.
Proceeds earmarked for AZ copper project
The company says it will use an amount equal to proceeds for eligible Canadian exploration expenditures on the project.
The placement issues new shares, diluting existing holders; the release gives no pre-placement share count for comparison.
Closing expected on or about Dec. 10, 2026
Timing is subject to customary conditions, including required regulatory approvals.

This is a financing event for an exploration-stage company, rather than confirmation of a producing-business trend. Closing, regulatory approvals and deployment of proceeds on the AZ copper project are the next events to monitor.
from Yukon Metals Corp. distributed by GlobeNewswire.
